data: How many different training set sizes were used to train the model?

The caption states that the series represent training the model with the entire training set, or randomly subsampled proportions of training data summing to 75%, 50%, and 25% of the original training set size. This means there are four different training set sizes used: 100%, 75%, 50%, and 25%. Therefore, the answer is 4.
